name: trackiq-amazon-listing-monitor
title: TrackIQ: Amazon Listing Monitor
summary: Watches a brand's listings daily and alerts only when something actually moved — a rewritten title or bullet, a lost image, a missing A+ description, a category move, a new seller in the buy box, price or rating past a threshold, or a listing that has stopped being purchasable. Each finding carries the revenue behind that ASIN. Silence is the normal output.

requires.third_party_note: Requires an Oxylabs scraper connection for listing state: 1 credit per watched ASIN per run. Listing state has to be observed from the public page — first-party data will not show a title rewrite. Also needs somewhere to keep dated snapshots between runs; without yesterday's snapshot there is nothing to diff.

delivery.note: Silence is the normal output — only sends when something moved. in-chat always works and is the fallback. Outward sends confirm first.

fallback: None. Without the scraper it cannot observe listing state, and without stored snapshots it can take a baseline and nothing more. The skill says so rather than pretending to monitor.
